biotools.summary: The Omics Dataset Curation Toolkit (OMD Curation Toolkit) is a Python package designed to facilitate the curation of public omics datasets, providing tools for download, metadata handling, and data integration. It aims to standardize the curation process and enable meta-analyses based on sequencing data.
